fact: On 25 September 2019 the deputy planning minister said the project of writing the police-station report and sending it electronically to prosecution and court had been applied initially in Port Said and New Cairo, with national roll-out intended.
title: التخطيط: مشروع لتحويل محاضر أقسام الشرطة إلكترونيا للنيابات والمحاكم
